content.name: Draconic Resilience
entries: The magic in your body manifests physical traits of your draconic gift. Your {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} maximum increases by 3, and it increases by 1 whenever you gain another Sorcerer level.
Parts of you are also covered by dragon-like scales. While you aren't wearing armor, your base {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52} equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Charisma modifiers.
